title: ERC_CoG PROMENADE - WP2 - MetaImagery (Metaphor and Mental Imagery)
description: EEG and behavioral dataset from 39 Italian-speaking university students performing a picture-matching task in which target pictures matched or mismatched a preceding cue. Cues were physical (picture), imagery (single word), literal sentence, or metaphorical sentence. The data are provided as preprocessed long epochs (filtered, mastoid re-referenced, ocular ICA cleaned). The dataset was collected within the ERC PROMENADE project to test how mental representations generated by different cue types influence target picture processing. Vocabulary and mental imagery measures are included per participant.
methods_description: 64-channel BrainVision actiCHamp EEG was recorded in an unshielded room with participants seated 85 cm from an EIZO monitor; responses were collected with a Cedrus RB-530 box. A block design presented Physical, Imagery, Literal and Metaphorical cue tasks with counterbalanced order. Data were band-pass filtered (0.1-45 Hz, 4th order IIR Butterworth), re-referenced to the average of the mastoids (TP9, TP10), and ocular components were removed with ICA. Epochs span 1.87 s before to 3.17 s after target onset.

funding_references.award_title: PROcessing MEtaphors: Neurochronometry Acquisition and Decay (PROMENADE)
